topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The news came like a sudden squall, catching us unawares. The old millhouse, where we've always known the warmth of the hearth and the comfort of walls that have heard our laughter and our laments, is to be turned into something new. Condos, they say. strangers will buy these walls, and the quiet that has long been ours may soon be a stranger to our threshold. Yet, in the churn of my heart, I find a whisper of the spring's first bloom. Change, it seems, brings its own harvest, and who am I to withhold the seed from the soil? We shall see what the earth yields in this new season.
